notes.title: Demo Update 0.4.0
notes.content:
This is a big update that changes a few of the characters, adds a new character, new items and new features in maps. This game also adds a new character select screen.
Demo Update 0.4.0Additions:
+ Added a new item: Adhesive Glue

+ Added a new item: Leech Knife

+ Added a quality of life addition to the character select where it remembers your previous selection

+ Loading screen now includes tips

+ At high difficulty levels, bosses spawn in like normal enemies

+ You can now see actively spawning enemies in the pause menu

+ Added a new character: Old Fool

+ Added a new ability for Skellington IV
Changes:
- Soul Charms are now a common item

- The way health regen works has been changed, health will regen 3 seconds after being hit, and this timer will be reset upon any further hits before the heal. After this, health will regen as normal

- Holy Sword damage nerfed from 150% -> 110%

- Quad-Launcher damage nerfed from 125% -> 100%

- Enemy health scaling has been changed from 25% health increase per level to 60% increase

- Holy Sword fire rate changed from 0.8 -> 1.0

- Holy Sword base area decreased from 1.0 -> 0.9

- Vampire slash cooldown reduced from 2 -> 1

- Vampire slash damage increased from 200% -> 225%

- Logbook has been overhauled

- Character select has been overhauled to show the character

- Loading screen has been changed

- Lowered most characters' default health

- B-hop mechanic works more consistently now when going up slopes

- Adjusted the way the game picks enemies to spawn in

- Missiles deal more splash damage

- Quad-Launcher damage increased 100% -> 125%

- The electric field is now unlocked via the Old Fool

- Character list has been re-organized

- The holy sword challenge now only requires 3 enemies to be hit at once

- XP now uses floats to calculate values, this makes the banana a more useful item as XP drops can have decimal values

- XP drops from enemies increases depending on their level

- Harder enemies, like bosses, drop more XP

- Enemies also drop an extra XP point per buff they have

- Blast beach now has lava pools

- Removed the sunset variant from stage 1
Fixes:
* Fixed the holy sword's slash's particles being inaccurate to where damage is going to be dealt

* Ditto this with the vampire slash

* Fixed the leaderboard on the main menu appearing over the top of the fade in

* Fixed the heat detector not showing particles properly when being equipped

* Fixed the holy sword challenge being broken

* Removed floating trees from grasslands

notes.title: Demo Update 0.3.1 - The Weapon Update
notes.content:
As the name suggests, this update is all about weapons. Most weapons have been adjusted and 3 new ones have been added.


Full Changelog:

Additions:
+ Added a new weapon: The Quad-Launcher
+ You can now hold the space button to b-hop instead of timing the key press
+ Added a new item: Tactical Heat Detector 
+ Added a new weapon: Holy Sword
+ Added a new ability to Alucard: Vampire Slash
+ Added a new weapon: BATS!
Changes:
- Scavenger's acceleration increased slightly
- Scavenger's scrap rocket has been changed visually
- Scavenger's scrap rocket's explosion is red and has an area visualiser
- The challenge menu has been organized a bit better
- Legendary drop chances changed in large chests
- Cigarettes no longer increase crit damage after 100%
- The Knight's default weapon is now the "Holy Sword"
- Alucard's dash has new particles
- Characters slow down faster, making them feel less slippery at higher speeds
- The rock golem fight has been made harder, the golem now summons both melee and ranged enemies
- The rock golem now attacks more frequently
- Rock golem enemy summons now appear around the player, instead of the golem
- Alucard's default weapon is now "BATS!"
Fixes:
* Fixed a large delay when first deploying the boombox

notes.title: Demo Update 0.3.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone. It's time for a new update and this one brings a lot of changes and should hopefully make it easier to focus down a specific build. We also have a new character who is a lot more unique than the others.



Additions:

+ Added a new interactable: Trading Station
+ Added a new character: The Scavenger
+ Added a new challenge for this survivor
+ Added a new stage: Blast Beach
+ Added a new item: Coffee
+ Added a new boss: Golem
+ Added a new item: Rocket Satchel
+ Added a new enemy buff: Metallic
+ Added a popup on the HUD when you complete a challenge
+ Added a new ability for the knight: Sky Sword
+ Characters can now b-hop by repeatedly jumping after a dash to keep their speed

Changes:

- Increased item pickup radius
- Stage 1 layout has been changed, making the map smaller and opening more paths to the 2 main areas
- Electric field damage buffed from 20% -> 45%
- Straight shooter damage buffed from 75% -> 100%
- Vacuum Module increased drop rate 4% -> 8%
- Dead Weights buffed to have a damage increase of 5%
- Rebalanced difficulty scaling for all difficulties
- Nerfed enemy damage gain per level
- The leaderboard category has been swapped round, making kills appear first by default, then stages completed next
- Elemental buffed enemies' attacks deal more damage now
- Your slot on the leaderboard is now blue to make it clearer
- Zap-A-Tron can now shock enemies and deals splash damage
- Leaderboard buttons are now part of the main leaderboard box
- The results screen's right box with the run info is now a big scroll box, instead of the challenges being a tiny scroll box
- Stage 3 now has more interactables in the map
- Mage heal ability cooldown changed 30 -> 60
- Character's accelerations have been increased

Fixes:

* Fixed skellington and clanker abilities not being based on base damage
* Fixed a bug where the straight shooter dealed 25% less damage on the 1st hit
* Fixed a bug in the 1st stage where interactables could spawn inside a rock
* Fixed a bug where the leaderboard would overflow if you were above rank 10
* Fixed the particles on the vacuum model when you first equip it
* Fixed golden enemies not flashing when hit
* Fixed the wrong default weapon showing up in the character select for Alucard

notes.title: Demo Update 0.2.5
notes.content:
This new update has focused on improving quality of life and fixing a few bugs that have been picked up.



As always be sure to join the discord and interact with the community, or if you need to report any bugs.



Additions:

+ Added kills to the leaderboard

+ Added a notification to the logbook to let you know when a new entry has become available

+ Added an objective to the screen to help guide new players



Changes:

- The ancient monolith now emits more particles and has a glow to the model's material

- Buffed energy drink speed boost from 10% -> 14%

- Buffed moonboots jump boost from 10% -> 20%

- Adjusted normal difficulty

- Levels now have more interactables

- Removed a prop from the 2nd stage

- Added more detail to 2nd stage

- Expanded chest location region in 2nd stage



Fixes:

* Fixed weird interaction issues with chests and pots

* Fixed issues with walking directly up walls

* Fixed a bug where enemies could launch themselves into space

notes.title: Demo Release
notes.content:
Hello wonderful people, the demo release for Nocturnal Throne is here. Be sure to join the Discord to drop in and speak to other people in the community.

So far in the demo we have these features:

3 levels
9 Weapons
29 items
4 buff types


If you encounter any issues or bugs, or have any suggestions, feel free to drop them over in the discord.

Join the discord here.

I have a lot planned for the future of the demo. The game will receive some content updates over the next few weeks to keep it fresh for a little while. Along with many many bug fixes that I assume people will discover.
